remarks: Don't miss the opportunity to own this charming, unique corner apartment. Light-filled and sunny, it has been freshly painted and features an updated kitchen with marble countertops and a brand new gas range and oven, as well as a refreshed bathroom. Conveniently on the 1st floor, enjoy easy access along with a separate, private side entrance. Two parking spaces in the adjacent lot, plus a storage unit. Located just a few blocks away from I-95, Chelsea Piers, restaurants and Cove Island beach. Common Charge includes heat, water, lawn maintenance, snow and trash removal.
